title: Shared definitions for HalfPress catalog entries

id.description: Lowercase slug, unique across the whole catalog. Must match the file name without .json.

fNumber.description: Aperture as an f-number, e.g. 1.8 for f/1.8.

shutterSpeed.description: Shutter speed as written on the camera: a fraction like "1/4000" or whole seconds like "30".

stops.description: Rated stops of correction, as the maker states it. Omit when unknown.

source.description: Where the values came from and how far they have been checked.

retrieved.description: Date the source page was read, YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: draft: added, not yet checked. sourced: every field matches the source page. verified: a second person confirmed it.
